ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
B3-1, Community Shopping Districts and indications as shown on Map No. 7-J in
the area bound by:

      North Milwaukee Avenue, a line 155 feet northwest of North Kimball Avenue as
      measured along the southwesterly line of North Milwaukee Avenue and perpendicular
      thereto; a line 156 feet west of and parallel to North Kimball Avenue; West Diversey
      Avenue; a line 181 feet west of and parallel to North Kimball Avenue; and a line 180 feet
      northwest of North Kimball Avenue as measured along the southwesterly line of North
      Milwaukee Avenue and perpendicular thereto,

to those of a B3-3, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          __________________________
                                                          Carlos Ramirez-Rosa
                                                          Alderman, 35th Ward




Common Address:
2814 N. Milwaukee Avenue
